_comment: Domain-to-category map (Entertainment / Education / Games / Tools). Sourced from two places: (1) a small hand-curated set of well-known sites (the ones without an obvious blocklist-style source -- search engines, dev tools, productivity software, streaming services), and (2) the Universite Toulouse Capitole UT1 blacklists (github.com/olbat/ut1-blacklists, CC BY-SA, ~45k domains as of this import) for Games (their games/ list), Education (liste_bu/ -- university library/academic resources -- and educational_games/), and Entertainment (social_networks/, audio-video/, chat/, manga/, radio/, sports/). UT1 has no general-purpose "productivity tools" category (it exists to block distracting/harmful content, not to catalog software), so Tools stays hand-curated and is the thinnest of the four. Anything not in this file falls back to "Other" in screentime_categories.py. Hand-curated entries always take priority over UT1 ones for the same domain.
